description.narrative: Number of alternative care initiatives started and being implemented disaggregated per country

comment.narrative: The baseline for this indicator is 9 it includes data from Zambia 3 and Mexico 6 as of the end of March 2021 as target values are not cumulative to the baseline values it has been decided to keep all baselines as 0 in the system.
Target revised as per NCE 2023 Please note that the target and achievements do consider twice the same type of care model when implemented in two different countries.

Under output 3.2 the programme reports on the number of alternative care initiatives started and being implemented in each country indicator 3.2.1. The work of indicators definition undertaken internally in the last quarter of 2022 for more details please refer to the section 8. Action coordination monitoring and evaluation led the programme teams to recognize that output indicator 3.2.1 and outcome indicator 3.2 count the same number of alternative care options without making a difference between the type of models and the type of initiatives.The programme therefore reports on both indicators the community and familybased care models such as kinship care foster care residential care supervised independent living implemented at nationalstatedistrict level as alternative options to detention of children on the move. It has to be noted that target and achievement do consider twice the same type of care model when implemented in two different countries. As an example this means that if two countries have in place a foster care model this is reported as two different initiatives. To date alternative care models are implemented in the four participating countries as described in the section Outcome 3 Child protection systems provide alternative care options with emphasis on community and familybased alternatives.During the first interim report some of the country teams have reported under output indicator 3.2.1 the number of statesdistricts on which alternative care initiatives were implemented. The discrepancy present in the logframe where 12 alternative models are reported under outcome indicator 3.2 and 13 under output indicator 3.2.1 stems from the difficulty to align the achievements already reported in 2021 with the harmonized indicator definition.
